title: RNA-seq of Human, Sheep and Rat Mesenchymal Stromal Cells
description: Isolated mesenchymal stromal cells (MSC) were obtained from either adipose or bone marrow from rat and sheep. Human MSC were purchased from Lonza. All MSC were expanded on tissue culture plastic in standard culture conditions.

samples.title: A1
samples.description: Protocols: After incubation, cells were rinsed in PBS twice before being lysed directly in Buffer RLT Plus from the RNeasy plus micro kit (Qiagen, Victoria, Australia). Cells were cultured in a humidified incubator at 37ºC, with 5% carbon dioxide. Growth medium provided contains 1 g/L D-glucose (Gibco, Victoria, Australia) Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM), L-Glutamine and 110 mg/L Sodium pyruvate, supplemented with 10% foetal bovine serum (Bovogen, Victoria, Australia) and 1% Penicillin-Streptomycin (Gibco, Victoria, Australia). Total RNA was extracted from lysed cells using the RNeasy Plus Micro kit (Qiagen, Victoria, Australia). Quality of RNA was determined on the 2100 BioAnalyzer (Agilent Technologies, Victoria, Australia). All samples of at least an RNA Integrity Number (RIN) of ≥ 8.0 and an A260/280 ratio of 1.8 – 2.0 were accepted. Library preparation was performed on 1 µg total RNA per sample with the Illumina TruSeq® Stranded mRNA kit according to manufacturer’s protocol (Illumina, San Diego, California).
attributes: adipose tissue derived mesenchymal stem cell
